name: Bug Zapper
blurb: Report something broken and follow it until it's fixed.
checks: Open Bug Zapper from the Community menu and tap Report a bug.
Fill in the short name, what happened and what you expected, and pick How bad.
Attach a screenshot, check its preview shows, then close the form without sending.
Turn on My reports and open one of your earlier reports, if you have one.
Open someone else's report and tap Bit me too, then tap it again to undo it.
